info.title: Execution exact stage daily-close read
info.description: Explicit numeric_format=DECIMAL_STRING on the existing session/workspace-authorized route. Omitting it retains legacy V1 number wire; this document describes only the opt-in successor. No additional source stream or grant. Currency missing/invalid/mixed is typed absence, not guessed from environment. Current read authority is rechecked before delivery.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Omitted: all retained history, subject to explicit row/byte refusal bounds. No silent truncation.

200.description: Calendar strictly increasing; all stage series/reason arrays have calendar length. Non-null point iff point reason null; requires deployed, non-null currency, null stage reason. Null point always has typed reason. No forward fill, FX conversion or totals across environments. These array-position/length constraints are enforced by producer Zod and consumer contract tests, not standard JSON Schema. A valid string is not financial certification. Bound: 20000 source account/day rows per stage, 20000 calendar days and 1MiB serialized response. Overflow refuses whole read with 503, never truncates.
